response.text: The data supports four confirmed findings. Submitting now.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", p."STRT_DT", p."END_DT", p."CLOSE_DT" FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p ON p."PRD_ID" = h."PRD_ID" WHERE h."POST_DT" < p."STRT_DT" OR h."POST_DT" > p."END_DT" OR (p."STAT_CD" = 'C' AND h."POST_DT" > p."CLOSE_DT")
findings.summary: Journals 2469 (PRD_ID 1, POST_DT 20240222) and 2470 (PRD_ID 2, POST_DT 20240326) are GL-sourced entries dated outside their period's date range (period 1 = 20240101-20240131, period 2 = 20240201-20240229) and were posted after those periods were closed (CLOSE_DT 20240205 and 20240305).

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT i."INV_ID", i."VEND_CD", i."INV_NO", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD", i."JRNL_NO" FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."INV_ID" IN (324, 802)
findings.summary: Invoice V0007-52774-324 is recorded twice: INV_ID 324 (status P, journal 1524) and INV_ID 802 (status O, journal 2468), same vendor V0007, same INV_NO once spaces/punctuation are normalised, same date and amount 17279.89. INV_ID 802 is an open duplicate that could be paid again.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT i."INV_ID", i."VEND_CD", i."INV_NO", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD", i."JRNL_NO" FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."INV_ID" IN (690, 801)
findings.summary: Invoice V0020-84200-690 is recorded twice: INV_ID 690 (status P, journal 2130) and INV_ID 801 (status O, journal 2467), same vendor V0020, same normalised INV_NO, same date and amount 16634.31. INV_ID 801 is an open duplicate.

findings.evidence_sql: SELECT i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD", COALESCE(SUM(p."PAY_AMT"),0) AS paid FROM "APINVH" i LEFT JOIN "APPAYM" p ON p."INV_ID" = i."INV_ID" GROUP BY i."INV_ID", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD" HAVING ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(p."PAY_AMT"),0) - i."INV_AMT", 2) <> 0 AND i."STAT_CD" = 'P'
findings.summary: Invoice INV_ID 126 is marked paid (P) but its payments total 8180.75 against an invoice amount of 8180.76, leaving 0.01 unpaid; the status and payment records disagree.
